works.name: HEARTH
works.description: Giant wood-fired sculpture at the Heart of Burning Man; co-designed/built with Syd Klinge; where Charlie met Brian Doherty

works.name: Synapses Tour
works.key_events: Six cities (NYC/Atlanta/Austin/LA/Seattle/SF) then Burning Man 2005 Fire Dream Circle
works.description: Six workshops in six cities over six months with Jaime Ladet; each city built and kept its own fire cauldron; shown at BM 2005 in the Fire Dream Circle around Pepe Ozan's Dreamer (with Flaming Lotus Girls)

works.name: Contraptions
works.description: His 2007 BM installation literally titled 'Contraptions' — the direct root of contraptionism.com

works.name: Triple Bypass
works.description: Studio-built over 6 weeks; helped instigate AfrikaBurn; described as the first Burning-Man-represented artifact there

works.name: Hot Mama
works.description: Part of the fertility-caldron series with Mr. Nice Guy and the Waking Rooster

works.name: Mr. Nice Guy
works.description: Companion to Hot Mama in the fertility caldron series

works.name: The Fleeble Flobbler
works.key_events: Burning Man 2008; Okeechobee; Suwannee Hulaween Spirit Lake 2023; festivals
works.description: 22-ft rotund clown fire cauldron with eight rider seats on a pivoting base; later a flame-effects machine; recurring at Hulaween Spirit Lake (2023)

works.name: Bone Head
works.description: Shown at Desert Rock Festival in Dubai

works.name: Teetering Cusps
works.key_events: Starlight Drive-In 2003; End of the World 2008
works.description: Recurring teetering fire piece across regional events

works.name: Tunnel of Transformation
works.description: Black Rock Arts Foundation grant 2003 (with Michael Moss; 4 of 117 chosen); toured US regional burns 2003-04

works.name: The Gantry
works.key_events: Steamboat Springs decom 2003; 'to the moon' TN 2024
works.description: Recurring metallic effigy; a 2024 example is used to illustrate Burning Book congregation

works.name: Ganesha
works.description: Large metal elephant-deity (Ganesha) effigy — rare build + detail shots from Okeechobee 2017; named by Charlie/KK in the 2023 interview

works.name: 24/7 A Time Star
works.aka: Timing Is Everything (BM 2012) / A 24/7 Timestar Lives (BeltLine 2015)
works.key_events: Burning Man 2012 honorarium; Atlanta Historic 4th Ward 2015-2018 (debut at BeltLine Lantern Parade)
works.description: Seven-sided interactive star built by 100+ people; official BM 2012 title 'Timing Is Everything'; 24 ft; 2.5-yr Atlanta install via Art on the BeltLine + BRAF; local 'starfie' landmark

works.name: Uncle Charlie's Red Hot Cock
works.scale: 12'x30' base; 25-30 ft tall (50 ft per KK)
works.description: Jackal-headed rooster teeter-totter that burns wood; ~40 crew; 2-2.5 cords; KK was quartermaster/documentarian

works.name: The Solar Scope
works.description: Tuned mechanical sun/time device set on a 60-degree parallel; built with his cousin (a math artist)

works.name: The Burning Book of Brian
works.status: planned (independent; NOT an official BM honorarium)
works.themes: memorial; pulsing heart; the royal we
works.description: Memorial effigy for Brian Doherty with a pulsing LPG heart; community-built; 8-10 collaborating artists; independent/community-funded (not on the 75-project 2026 honoraria list)
